channel.title: Comic99 News
channel.description: Auto-curated comic, manga and anime news by Comic99

item.title: Identity V Game's Oha Suta Daigo Gakuen Short Anime Unveils More Cast, Staff, November 24 Debut
item.description: A short anime based on the Identity V game will premiere November 24, featuring voice actors Takehito Koyasu, Nobunaga Shimazaki, Yūichirō Umehara, and Makoto Furukawa.

item.title: One Piece 1199 Spoilers: Luffy Goes Berserk in Elbaf, Robin Finds Lily's Letter, and Is the Nika Mystery Revealed? - Akt
item.description: Chapter 1199 of One Piece features Luffy experiencing an uncontrolled outburst in Elbaf, while Robin discovers a significant letter from Lily. The chapter may also provide answers regarding the Nika mystery.

item.title: One Piece Chapter 1199 Release Date, Time & Where to Read - AOL.com
item.description: Information about the upcoming installment in the long-running manga series is available, with details on its release timing and where fans can access it.

item.title: Frieren Joins Mahjong Soul Game for Limited-Time Crossover
item.description: The anime series Frieren has partnered with Mahjong Soul for a limited-time crossover event featuring the popular tile game.

item.title: 'Isekai Munchkin' Reveals New Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
item.description: The television adaptation of the manga series Isekai Munchkin has announced additional voice cast members, new production staff, and theme songs alongside a second promotional video.

item.title: Every Naruto Hokage, Ranked From Weakest to Strongest
item.description: A ranking of Naruto's village leaders examines their comparative strength levels, noting significant power gaps between the strongest and weakest leaders throughout the series.

item.title: The Best Calvin and Hobbes Comics About Watching TV
item.description: Calvin and Hobbes explores universal childhood experiences through its storytelling, including the relatable habit of television consumption during formative years.

item.title: Gundam Fans Officially Vote 1 of Its Most Popular Mecha Back Into Production
item.description: Bandai is re-releasing an action figure based on the Gundam 00 mecha series more than five years after its last production run, coinciding with the franchise's 20th anniversary milestone.

item.title: 7 Classic Toonami Anime That Went Too Far for American Television
item.description: Several anime programs that aired on Toonami, including Outlaw Star, faced significant edits due to content deemed inappropriate for American broadcast standards.

item.title: Yaiba: Samurai Legend Season 2 Reveals Cast Member Yūma Uchida, Opening Song Artists
item.description: The second season of Yaiba: Samurai Legend has announced voice actor Yūma Uchida in the role of Gekkō, alongside CHiCO with HoneyWorks performing the opening theme song "CHASE!"

item.title: Otherworldly Munchkin Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, January 7 Debut
item.description: A new promotional video for the otherworldly munchkin series unveiled additional cast members and production staff following a lengthy production delay. The anime will premiere on January 7, featuring actor Yūichirō Umehara among its ensemble cast alongside newly announced opening and closing themes.

item.title: Archive of Our Own Site Reopens Following 'Security Incident'
item.description: Archive of Our Own, a popular fanfiction repository for anime and manga content, has resumed operations after experiencing a security issue. The site temporarily disabled certain features to expedite its return to service.

item.title: Sakamoto Days Season 2's Trailer Unveils More Cast, Opening Song, January 18 Debut
item.description: The second season of Sakamoto Days will premiere January 18, featuring newly announced cast members Kenyū Horiuchi and Kishō Taniyama. Creepy Nuts will perform the opening theme.

item.title: 'Sakamoto Days 2nd Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
item.description: The upcoming second season of the Sakamoto Days anime revealed additional cast members, an opening theme song, and a promotional video. The show is set to air on TV Tokyo.

item.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Officially Rewrites the Shibuya Incident With New Alternate Story - Comic Book Resources
item.description: Jujutsu Kaisen has introduced an alternate take on the Shibuya Incident storyline. The new version offers a different narrative perspective on this major arc.

item.title: 'Soara to Mamono no Ie' Announces Additional Cast Pair
item.description: The television adaptation of Hidenori Yamaji's adventure fantasy manga announced additional voice cast members and a new visual. The series is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

item.title: 5 Strongest Bleach Characters Without a Bankai, Ranked
item.description: A Comic Book Resources ranking examines five of the most formidable fighters in Bleach who have demonstrated considerable power without ever obtaining Bankai abilities.

item.title: Star Wars Star Giancarlo Esposito's New Comic Is The Venetian
item.description: Actor Giancarlo Esposito, known for his Star Wars role, has released a new graphic novel titled The Venetian. The project marks his entry into the comics medium.

item.title: Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ Manga Ends
item.description: The manga series Yametai! ~Anata no Reset, Daikō Shimasu~ by Jun Esaka and Kine Usuto has concluded. The work ran since its January debut.

item.title: Black Clover Season 2 ‒ Episode 177
item.description: In the latest installment of Black Clover's second season, character developments continue as Noelle receives positive focus. The episode airs as part of the ongoing anime adaptation.
